name: crispe-system-architect-plugin
description: Expert program architecture analyzer that generates documentation for any code repository. Supports three output styles: Choice 1 (CONTRIBUTING.md + STRUCTURE.md), Choice 2 (CLAUDE.md only), Choice 3 (STRUCTURE.md only). STRUCTURE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and OVERVIEW.md are treated as equivalent. Proactively triggers before code changes when no architectural overview exists.
